summary: Sullivan has acted to shield Israel's military capacity and delegitimize Palestinian solidarity. He co-signed a 2023 letter to Harvard demanding condemnation of pro-Palestinian student speech, voted against three 2024 Senate resolutions blocking arms sales to Israel while calling the effort 'dangerous anti-Semitism,' and introduced the United States–Israel Defense Partnership Act in February 2025 to expand counter-drone and anti-tunneling cooperation.
